hardening.minimized_reason: Build libcap without its PAM module, pam_cap, so the library and its utilities depend on no libpam.
hardening.pledge_reason: No package-enforced pledge-style capability policy is claimed; each Werewolf form confines the capabilities its services hold.

changes.what: Build and install with PAM_CAP=no, and drop linux-pam-dev and the chmod of pam_cap.so.
changes.why: pam_cap.so made every libcap consumer, Squid and Samba among them, depend on libpam, which brought pam_unix and its unix_chkpwd helper into images that check no UNIX password. Werewolf has no PAM use.

wolfi.removal_condition: Wolfi moves pam_cap into a subpackage of its own, so libcap no longer depends on libpam; review before retiring this overlay.
